reply.text:
Cutting weight in 3 days is one I won't coach. Rapid cuts, like dropping water or starving down to a weigh-in, are a health risk, and that's one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, ideally one who works with combat athletes. If you're close to the limit, they can tell you what's safe for your body.

What I can help with is the training side. I can keep your sessions sharp through fight week, or build you a program for after the tournament. Tell me which you want.
